description: This Java class 'CommandWrapper' encapsulates command details for the Fineract platform, including resource identifiers, action types, and resource-specific methods for command processing.

classes.name: CommandWrapper
classes.description: A class representing command details with various resource and action attributes, providing methods to determine command types and resource characteristics.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a CommandWrapper instance with minimal parameters for a specific action and resource.

methods.name: fromExistingCommand
methods.description: Creates a CommandWrapper instance based on an existing command with detailed resource and action information.

methods.name: isCreate
methods.description: Checks if the command action is 'CREATE'.

methods.name: isCreateDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the command is a create operation on a datatable resource.

methods.name: isDeleteDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the command is a delete operation on a datatable resource.

methods.name: isUpdateDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the command is an update operation on a datatable resource.

methods.name: isDatatableResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is a datatable.

methods.name: isDeleteOneToOne
methods.description: Checks if the command is a delete operation on a one-to-one resource.

methods.name: isDeleteMultiple
methods.description: Checks if the command is a delete operation on multiple subresources.

methods.name: isUpdateOneToOne
methods.description: Checks if the command is an update on a one-to-one resource.

methods.name: isUpdateMultiple
methods.description: Checks if the command is an update on multiple subresources.

methods.name: isRegisterDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the command is a register operation on a datatable.

methods.name: isNoteResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is a note type (client, loan, saving, group).

methods.name: isChangeOfOwnUserDetails
methods.description: Checks if the command involves changing details of the logged-in user.

methods.name: isUpdate
methods.description: Determines if the command is an update operation, considering special resource cases.

methods.name: isCacheResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is a cache.

methods.name: isChangePasswordOperation
methods.description: Checks if the action is a password change.

methods.name: isUpdateOperation
methods.description: Checks if the action is an update.

methods.name: isDelete
methods.description: Checks if the command is a delete operation on a specific resource.

methods.name: isDeleteOperation
methods.description: Checks if the action is delete.

methods.name: isSurveyResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is a survey.

methods.name: isRegisterSurvey
methods.description: Checks if the action is register on a survey.

methods.name: isFullFilSurvey
methods.description: Checks if the action is create on a survey.

methods.name: isWorkingDaysResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is working days.

methods.name: isPasswordPreferencesResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is password preferences.

methods.name: isInterestPauseResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is interest pause.

methods.name: isInterestPauseCreateResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is interest pause creation.

methods.name: isInterestPauseUpdateResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is interest pause update.

methods.name: isInterestPauseDeleteResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is interest pause deletion.

methods.name: commandId
methods.description: Returns the command ID.

methods.name: resourceId

methods.name: subresourceId
methods.description: Returns the subresource ID.

methods.name: taskPermissionName
methods.description: Returns the task permission name, combining action and entity.

methods.name: isPermissionResource
methods.description: Checks if the entity is permission.

methods.name: isUserResource
methods.description: Checks if the entity is user.

methods.name: isCurrencyResource
methods.description: Checks if the entity is currency.

methods.name: commandName
methods.description: Returns the command name, combining action and entity.

methods.name: isLoanDisburseDetailResource
methods.description: Checks if the entity is disbursement detail.
